english.title: Use motor vehicle - disabled person seat belt not secured

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with a **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF BELT..) disabled person's seat belt in accordance with regulation 47 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 when the ends of the belt were not, when the seat belt was being used for the purpose for which it was designed and constructed, securely fastened either to some part of the structure of the vehicle or to the seat which was being occupied by the person wearing the belt so that the body of such person would be restrained in the event of an accident to the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 48(4)(g) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use a motor vehicle on a road fitted with a disabled person's seat belt
the seat belt was being used for the purpose of its design/construction
the ends of the belt were not securely fastened to the structure of the vehicle/seat
which was occupied by the person wearing it

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 48(5) for exceptions
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H3514 and H3515.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) fitted with a **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF BELT..) disabled person's seat belt. The belt was being used by a disabled person but the ends of the belt were not securely fastened either to the structure of the vehicle or to the seat itself.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

Fixed penalty ticket - fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
